title: Erromintxela language
text: Erromintxela is a para-Romani mixed language spoken by the Erromintxela subgroup of the Romani people in the Basque Country, deriving the majority of its lexicon from Kalderash Romani while incorporating Basque grammar, syntax, and phonology.
